title: Webhook to HTTP
description: The minimal scenario: instant webhook trigger forwards incoming data to a REST API.

title: Scheduled status poll
description: Polls an endpoint on a schedule and alerts on degraded status. No trigger module — any action can be first; scheduling lives outside the blueprint.

title: Filter gate
description: A simple yes/no condition implemented as a filter on the downstream module — the right tool when there is no second branch.

title: Lead intake — webhook, router, HTTP
description: Router with a filtered route and a fallback route, plus an error handler on the API call. The canonical multi-branch scenario.

title: If-else with merge
description: Exclusive branching that converges again: builtin:BasicIfElse evaluates branches in order and executes exactly one; builtin:BasicMerge joins merge-flagged branches back into a single flow.

title: Iterator and Aggregator
description: Splits an array into bundles, processes each item, and recombines into one result. The aggregator's feeder points at the module that opened the loop.

title: Error handler with logging
description: An error handler that is a full flow: log the failure to an external endpoint, then continue with builtin:Ignore.

title: Webhook API endpoint
description: A synchronous HTTP API built from a scenario: webhook in, custom JSON response out via gateway:WebhookRespond.

title: Data store dedupe
description: Idempotent processing: check a data store for the record's key and only process records not seen before.

title: Rate-limited loop
description: One API call per array item with a sleep between calls to respect rate limits.
